headline.conclusion: The headline corpus synthesis reports are reproducible from committed inputs. Source-scanning and rerun/property generators depend on local pinned corpus caches, but committed v5/v6/v7/recovery manifests are sufficient reconstruction manifests for sampled rows. Those scripts now fail on missing or mismatched denominators instead of silently measuring a partial cache.

manifestReconstruction.conclusion: The source caches are local artifacts, but the committed manifests contain repo/path/commit/hash pointers for every row. A deterministic 40-row-per-corpus sample still refetched from raw GitHub and matched manifest hashes byte-for-byte after the documented normalization.
